channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: Michelle Yeoh Is Just Hoping She’s “Made a Difference for Actors Who Look Like Me”
item.description: In a sit-down interview with The Hollywood Reporter, this year's Berlin Film Festival Golden Bear recipient reveals how her life has changed post-Oscar win and what she thinks of those 'Wicked: For Good' snubs.

item.title: Don Lemon Says He’s “Grateful” Arrest Boosted His Online Career
item.description: The former CNN anchor was arrested last month after covering an anti-ICE protest that took place at a Minnesota church.

item.title: Barack Obama Reacts to Donald Trump Posting Video Depicting Him and Michelle Obama as Apes
item.description: "It is true that it gets attention. It’s true that it’s a distraction," he said during a Saturday interview with Brian Tyler Cohen.

item.title: ‘Animol’ Review: Knife-Edge Youth Prison Drama Featuring Stephen Graham Is a Tough Watch Tempered With Vulnerability, Heart and Hope
item.description: Tut Nyuot plays a new inmate at a Northeast England detention center for young offenders in 'Adolescence' actor Ashley Walters’ directing debut.

item.title: Providence Equity in Support of Wasserman Agency Sale: “We Remain Fully Committed”
item.description: "We believe deeply in the strength of the Company and have full confidence in Mike and the leadership team," a spokesperson for the private equity firm said amid news that Casey Wasserman is putting the company up for sale.

item.title: ‘It’s Time to Burn Down The House’: Karim Aïnouz on Eviscerating the Super-Rich in ‘Rosebush Pruning’
item.description: An all-star cast — including Callum Turner, Jamie Bell, Riley Keough, Elle Fanning, and Pamela Anderson — play a violently dysfunctional family in film that makes 'Saltburn' look tame.

item.title: ‘A Child of My Own’ Review: Award-Winning Chilean Documaker Maite Alberdi Ventures North to Mexico for a Chronicle of a Faked Pregnancy
item.description: Ana Celeste Montalvo Peña plays a young woman driven to the edge of madness by her need to breed in the filmmaker's docu-fiction hybrid.

item.title: Make-Up Artists and Hair Stylists Guild Awards: ‘One Battle After Another,’ ‘Sinners’ Top Film Winners
item.description: 'The Studio,' 'Palm Royale,' 'Saturday Night Live' and 'Skeleton Crew' were the top winners in the TV categories at the ceremony that also recognized Amy Madigan, Michael Johnston and Greg Nelson and Judy Alexandra Cory with honorary awards.

item.title: Berlin Flashback: Jamie Bell’s First Fest Foray Was ‘Hallam Foe’
item.description: From teen breakout to seasoned leading man, the British actor returns to the Berlinale with a competition film that echoes the emotional themes of his early work.
